decision.rationale: Use Muon hybrid for the single formal seed-42 pretraining run.

semantic_batch_rationale: Moonlight Table 2 uses 160 examples at 8K for its 822M non-embedding / 20.76B-token scaling-law model. The token-equivalent 4K batch is 320 examples, or 1,310,720 tokens/update.

target_gate.requirements: Prove eval-triggered CUDA Graph recapture, reach the first post-warmup update with finite loss and gradient norm, then independently resume the exact warmup-boundary checkpoint for that update under the same signed recipe.
